explanation: Matches the first question on erdosproblems.com/1074: does the EHS set S have a natural density? S = {m ≥ 1 : some prime p ≢ 1 (mod m) divides m! + 1} matches the page. m = 1 is automatically excluded, since everything is ≡ 1 mod 1, which is consistent with the sequence starting 8, 9, 13, … (A064164).
